relation_to_existing_cohort: Additive dataset only. Never overwrite HCS-BLIND-20-2026-10-14 source questions, three-year windows, or direct-resolution labels.

source_only_selection.exclude_ids: all 20 arxiv IDs in data/historical_cs_blind_cohort_20.jsonl, plus previous four pilot IDs
source_only_selection.sampling: one SHA-256 hash-priority title-eligible paper per topic/year cell using fixed seed hcs-observable-title-2026-10-14-v1; no later citation, abstract revision or outcome feature used
source_only_selection.eligibility_stage: Selection is only an outcome-observability proxy. An exact cutoff-version full-text source screen must verify an explicitly open question, object, metric/property, and falsification condition before any future search. Keep ineligible and inaccessible rows in the denominator.

cutoff: publication-year end as recorded in the source frame; verify requested version was public by cutoff
future_window: strictly after cutoff through the end of cutoff year plus five years, inclusive; no extension after viewing results
adjudication_unit: one frozen question per eligible source paper; related publications and versions grouped by arxiv ID or verified research family

dimensions.direct_scientific_resolution: A dated primary source directly tests the same object and prespecified outcome/assumptions or proves the same formal proposition. Record support or refutation, not a generic success flag.
dimensions.premise_refutation_or_revision: A dated primary result directly undermines a necessary premise under matched definitions; separate this from direct resolution and from pre-cutoff prior art.
dimensions.partial_progress: A dated primary result establishes a strict subcase, weaker guarantee, narrower population, proxy endpoint, or one component of a conjunction without settling the frozen question.
dimensions.independent_evidence_strengthening: A distinct author team or independent data/code reproduces or strengthens a relevant claim with a verifiable metric; same-team follow-up alone does not count as independent.
dimensions.contradictory_evidence: Dated primary results disagree on a matched or explicitly comparable claim, with assumptions and discrepancy recorded; differing tasks alone are not contradiction.
dimensions.scope_narrowing_or_reformulation: A dated primary source explicitly narrows the question's domain, assumptions or metric; reviewer inference alone is a note, not a positive dimension.
dimensions.continued_explicit_uncertainty: An in-window primary source explicitly states that the same defined question remains open or directly reports an inconclusive test. A failed search never counts.
dimensions.unadjudicated: Evidence is absent, inaccessible, outside the fixed window, only topically related, or lacks a verifiable date/match. This is missingness, not a negative outcome.

row_values: For each of the first seven dimensions use supported, contradicted, not_observed_after_bounded_search, or not_assessable; record every supporting URL, first-public date, PDF page/section, exact scope and independent-unit caveat. Unadjudicated is a separate row-level flag. Not_observed is not evidence of absence.
adjudication_order: screen exact cutoff-version primary full text and lock one question
record prespecified object, comparator and gate
verify primary full text and first-public date
assign each dimension independently with provenance and exclusions
analysis_gate: Report per-dimension observed positives, assessable denominators, missingness by topic/year and exact binomial intervals. Do not fit or score Paper 3 until temporally split, grouped held-out units include enough positive and negative directly adjudicated outcomes; absence-of-hit rows are not negatives.
bias_controls: No outcome-informed replacement or survivor-only cohort
No retrospective change to the old rubric
Positive controls, if added, are separately named case-control diagnostics and excluded from prevalence/forecast validation
